title: Magnetic field magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly solves for B in part (1) as B = √2 mv₀ / (2qd).

title: Electric field magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly solves for E in part (2) as E = √2 mv₀² / (2qd).

title: Total return time
description: Essential: Correctly expresses the total time in part (3) as t = n(10√2π + 8√2)d/v₀, including the integer n.

title: Circular motion geometry
description: Important: Correctly relates the geometry (e.g., chord length 2d) to the radius of circular motion using the 45° injection angle.

title: Lorentz force centripetal condition
description: Important: Applies qvB = mv²/r to relate B, v₀, m, q, and the radius for all parts.

title: Collision kinematics
description: Important: Correctly models the velocity component reversal (horizontal) and constancy (vertical) upon collision with the insulating plate.

title: Electric field kinematics
description: Important: For part (2), correctly applies kinematics under constant electric force to relate displacement, time, and acceleration (a = Eq/m).

title: Time segment summation
description: Optional: Correctly sums the times spent in magnetic field arcs and in straight-line motion between collisions for the periodic motion in part (3).

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Misapplies sign for reversed velocity component after collision or direction of electric force.

title: Radius confusion
description: Pitfall: Uses diameter instead of radius in geometric relations (e.g., chord = 2r sinθ) or in the centripetal force equation.
